profile.summary: Northern California ReLiEF is a joint powers authority (JPA), a group of public school agencies that share risk and insurance costs. It is one of two regional programs of the Regional Liability Excess Fund (ReLiEF), the other being Southern California ReLiEF. It is described as non-profit and owned and run by its members, and is administered by Keenan.
